source.title: NIST SP 800-60 Vol. 2 Rev. 1, Volume II: Appendices to Guide for Mapping Types of Information and Information Systems to Security Categories
source.status: Final. Rev. 2 has been an initial working draft since January 2024 and is not used here.

notes: Impact levels are the provisional levels NIST recommends. Organizations review and adjust them.
'footnoted' lists objectives whose level carries a footnote in the source (an exception or special factor).
'source_discrepancies' lists places where the Security Category line and the 'Recommended ... Impact Level' sentence in the same section disagree; the Security Category line is used.
